record.t: Announced Senate passage of a bill suspending Ohio's gas tax and diesel tax for 90 days.
record.q: Columbus-Senate President Rob McColley announced the passage of a bill suspending Ohio's 38.5 cent per gallon gas tax and 47 cent per gallon diesel tax for 90 days.

record.t: Announced passage of Ohio's new Capital Budget, including nearly $10 million for community projects in the 1st Senate District.
record.q: Senate President Rob McColley announced the passage of Ohio's new Capital Budget, securing nearly $10 million for community projects in the 1st Senate District.

record.t: Was unanimously elected President of the Ohio Senate for the 136th General Assembly.
record.q: Senator Rob McColley was unanimously elected President of the Ohio Senate in January of 2025, and will preside over the Upper Chamber during the 136th General Assembly.

record.t: Began serving in the Ohio Senate after being appointed.
record.q: President McColley began serving in Senate after being appointed in December 2017.

record.t: Was elected by Senate colleagues as Senate Majority Floor Leader for the 135th General Assembly.

record.t: Was sworn in to the Ohio House and as Assistant Majority Whip for the 132nd General Assembly.
record.q: State Representative Rob McColley (R-Napoleon) today was sworn in as a member of the Ohio House of Representatives and as the Assistant Majority Whip for the 132 nd General Assembly.

record.t: Recognized the 2024 National Championship Ohio State football team with a presentation in the Ohio Senate.
